syllabus_topics: Basic concepts of continuous-time (ct) and discrete-time (dt) signals. Examples. Transformations.
Basic concepts of systems. Memory, causality, invariance, linearity, stability, invertibility.
Linear Time-Invariant (LTI) systems. Unit impulse response. Convolution. Properties.
Laplace Transform (LT). Transfer Function (TF). LTI systems described by differential equations, poles and zeros. Relationship of TF with LTI system properties. Inverse LT and unilateral LT.
Fourier Transform (FT) of ct signals. Representation of aperiodic signals via FT. Frequency response, filtering. Relationship with Fourier Series (FS) for periodic signals.
Fourier Transform of dt signals. Concept of dt signal spectrum. LTI systems described by difference equations.
Sampling. dt processing of ct signals. Sampling theorem. Aliasing.
assessment_rules: For 'normal season', the final grade is calculated as 48% Exam + 12% MAP30 + 40% Laboratory. A minimum grade of 8 is required in the exam and in the weighted average of 80% exam + 20% MAP30. If the exam grade is higher than the MAP30 grade, it replaces the MAP30 grade in the formula. For 'resit season', 'student workers', and 'special season', the final grade is 60% Exam + 40% Laboratory. A minimum grade of 8 is required in the exam and 9.5 in the laboratory work for these seasons.
